```{r}
# ============================
# NAIVE BAYES SIMPLE sobre dades_imputades
#   - sense balanceig
#   - amb oversampling ("up")
# ============================

library(caret)
library(naivebayes)
library(dplyr)

# Funció per calcular F1 a partir de la confusionMatrix
f1_fun <- function(cm){
  prec <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"])
  rec  <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])
  2 * (prec * rec) / (prec + rec)
}

run_nb_model <- function(df, nom_data, cols_drop, sampling = NULL){
  cat("\n==========================\n")
  cat(" Dataset:", nom_data, "| sampling =", ifelse(is.null(sampling), "sense", sampling), "\n")
  cat("==========================\n")
  
  # 1) Separo train (amb Exited) i test (Kaggle)
  d_train <- df %>% filter(Group == "train")
  d_test  <- df %>% filter(Group == "test")
  
  # 2) Guardar ID del test per a la submissió
  id_test <- d_test$ID
  
  # 3) Elimino columnes que no vull al model
  d_train_mod <- d_train[, !(names(d_train) %in% cols_drop)]
  d_test_mod  <- d_test[,  !(names(d_test)  %in% cols_drop)]
  
  # 4) Converteixo Exited a factor Yes/No amb nivells fixos
  d_train_mod$Exited <- factor(
    ifelse(as.character(d_train_mod$Exited) %in% c("1","Yes","TRUE"), "Yes", "No"),
    levels = c("Yes","No")
  )
  
  # 5) Partició interna del train (70% train2 / 30% test2)
  set.seed(123)
  idx <- createDataPartition(d_train_mod$Exited, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
  train2 <- d_train_mod[idx, ]
  test2  <- d_train_mod[-idx, ]
  
  # 6) Noms de les variables predictors
  pred_cols <- setdiff(names(d_train_mod), "Exited")
  
  # 7) Control d’entrenament 
  ctrl <- trainControl(
    method     = "repeatedcv",
    number     = 3,    
    repeats    = 1,
    sampling   = sampling 
  )
  
  # 8) Petita graella d’hiperparàmetres per naive_bayes
  
  nb_grid <- expand.grid(
    laplace  = c(0, 1),
    usekernel= c(FALSE, TRUE),
    adjust   = 1
  )
  
  # 9) Entreno el model sobre train2 
  set.seed(123)
  mod_nb <- train(
    x         = train2[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE],
    y         = train2$Exited,
    method    = "naive_bayes",
    tuneGrid  = nb_grid,
    metric    = "Accuracy",
    trControl = ctrl
  )
  
  print(mod_nb)
  
  # 10) Prediccions train/test interns
  pred_tr <- predict(mod_nb, newdata = train2[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE], type = "raw")
  pred_te <- predict(mod_nb, newdata = test2[,  pred_cols, drop = FALSE], type = "raw")
  
  cm_tr <- confusionMatrix(pred_tr, train2$Exited, positive = "Yes")
  cm_te <- confusionMatrix(pred_te, test2$Exited,  positive = "Yes")
  
  f1_tr <- f1_fun(cm_tr)
  f1_te <- f1_fun(cm_te)
  
  kpis <- data.frame(
    Dataset            = c("Train_intern", "Test_intern"),
    Error_rate         = c(1 - cm_tr$overall["Accuracy"], 1 - cm_te$overall["Accuracy"]),
    Accuracy           = c(cm_tr$overall["Accuracy"],       cm_te$overall["Accuracy"]),
    Precision          = c(cm_tr$byClass["Pos Pred Value"], cm_te$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
    Recall_Sensitivity = c(cm_tr$byClass["Sensitivity"],    cm_te$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Specificity        = c(cm_tr$byClass["Specificity"],    cm_te$byClass["Specificity"]),
    F1_Score           = c(f1_tr, f1_te)
  )
  
  print(kpis)
  
  # 11) Re-entreno amb tot el train per generar submissió
  set.seed(123)
  mod_full <- train(
    x         = d_train_mod[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE],
    y         = d_train_mod$Exited,
    method    = "naive_bayes",
    tuneGrid  = mod_nb$bestTune,
    metric    = "Accuracy",
    trControl = ctrl
  )
  
  pred_kaggle <- predict(mod_full, newdata = d_test_mod[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE], type = "raw")
  
  submit <- data.frame(
    ID     = id_test,
    Exited = pred_kaggle
  )
  
  nom_fitxer <- paste0(
    "nb_", nom_data,
    ifelse(is.null(sampling), "_senseBalanceig", "_balanceig_up"),
    ".csv"
  )
  
  write.csv(submit, nom_fitxer, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nSubmissió guardada a:", nom_fitxer, "\n")
  
  invisible(list(
    model_cv   = mod_nb,
    model_full = mod_full,
    kpis       = kpis
  ))
}
cols_drop <- c("ID", "Surname", "Group")

# Sense balanceig
res_nb_imp_sense <- run_nb_model(
  df        = dades_imputades,
  nom_data  = "imputades",
  cols_drop = cols_drop,
  sampling  = NULL
)

# Amb oversampling
res_nb_imp_up <- run_nb_model(
  df        = dades_imputades,
  nom_data  = "imputades",
  cols_drop = cols_drop,
  sampling  = "up"
)

```

```{r}
# ============================
# NAIVE BAYES només amb variables seleccionades
#   Geography, Balance, Age, IsActiveMember,
#   NumOfProducts, NetPromoterScore, Gender
#   (amb i sense balanceig)
# ============================

# 1) Creo un dataset reduït només amb les variables d’interès
vars_keep_sel <- c(
  "ID", "Exited", "Group",   # per modelar i fer submissió
  "Geography", "Balance", "Age",
  "IsActiveMember", "NumOfProducts",
  "NetPromoterScore", "Gender"
)

dades_nb_reduides <- dades_imputades[, vars_keep_sel]
cols_drop_sel <- c("ID", "Group")

res_nb_red_sense <- run_nb_model(
  df        = dades_nb_reduides,
  nom_data  = "reduides",
  cols_drop = cols_drop_sel,
  sampling  = NULL
)

res_nb_red_up <- run_nb_model(
  df        = dades_nb_reduides,
  nom_data  = "reduides",
  cols_drop = cols_drop_sel,
  sampling  = "up"
)
```
